summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review threads from automated and human reviewers on the current branch by triaging, fixing, and replying to each comment.
summary.outcome: All 6 open review threads were resolved: 4 bugs fixed in commit caaf557, 1 marked not applicable (pre-existing SDK limitation), and 1 docs update to VERIFICATION.md.

repo: VERIFICATION.md files in .planning/phases/<phase>/ track verification evidence and can become stale when frontmatter is updated without cleaning up blocker language in the body.
Phase 36 is 'inline-upload-progress'; planning docs live at .planning/phases/36-inline-upload-progress/.

code.finding: Stale blocker language from initial verification was left in the body after frontmatter was updated, requiring a cleanup edit.

workflow: Use GraphQL reviewThreads query to fetch unresolved PR threads; filter by isResolved before triaging.
Reply to threads via REST (gh api repos/.../pulls/.../comments with --field in_reply_to as integer), resolve via GraphQL mutation resolveReviewThread.
The SDK cancel token issue (thread 4) was pre-existing and out of scope — marking as 'not applicable' with explanation is a valid resolution path.
Batch multiple fixes into a single commit before replying/resolving threads to keep the commit history clean.

friction: VERIFICATION.md had residual stale blocker language that wasn't cleaned up during an earlier update, requiring a separate follow-up edit and commit.
open_items: SDK cancel token limitation (thread 4) is a known pre-existing issue — not fixed, just acknowledged. Worth revisiting if the SDK adds support.
